description: Migration price derivation across quote decimal combinations and both pair orientations. Demonstrates that the on-chain raw-ratio calculation needs no decimal correction, while the human display price needs both decimal values.

units.sqrt_price_x64: Q64.64 fixed point, the Uniswap-V3 convention used by all three target venues

formulas.orientation_rule: Cetus enforces a canonical order over defining-id type-name bytes, and the meme type name embeds an unpredictable freshly published package address, so the adapter must handle both orientations. Evidence: CetusProtocol/cetus-contracts@ddfbdeba174319998b012de876ab7ec23c3ab0bc:packages/cetus_clmm/sources/factory.move:1074-1140

cases.name: sui_like_9dec_quote
cases.notes: MEME/SUI. Raw ratio and display price coincide only because the decimals are equal.

cases.name: usdc_like_6dec_quote
cases.notes: MEME/USDC. Raw ratio is 1000x smaller than the 9-decimal case, yet the display price is identical.

cases.name: lst_like_8dec_quote
cases.notes: MEME/sSUI-style liquid staking token at 8 decimals.

cases.name: meme_6dec_quote_9dec
cases.notes: Non-9-decimal meme. Present specifically so no formula may depend on the meme having 9 decimals.

properties.name: no_decimal_correction_on_chain
properties.statement: For a FIXED reserve state, changing the quote's decimals scales the raw atomic ratio by exactly 10^(meme_decimals - quote_decimals) and leaves the display price EXACTLY unchanged. Cases sui_like_9dec_quote, usdc_like_6dec_quote and lst_like_8dec_quote share the identical exact rational 990000000000/66666666666666667, which is the proof. The on-chain raw-ratio calculation therefore applies no decimal correction; only the display conversion does.
properties.caveat: meme_6dec_quote_9dec is a DIFFERENT reserve state, not a rescaling: a 6-decimal token cannot represent 200000000000000001 nine-decimal atomic units, so its meme reserve is truncated to 200000000000000. Its exact display price 297/20000000 therefore differs from the other three, and the two round alike only to 17 significant digits. Stating this prevents the false claim that all four are exactly equal.

properties.name: both_orientations_covered
properties.statement: Every case supplies the sqrt price for the meme as coin A and as coin B. The adapter must select by the venue's canonical ordering, not by assumption.

properties.name: range_guard
properties.statement: Every derived sqrt_price_x64 lies strictly inside [min_sqrt_price_x64, max_sqrt_price_x64]. A derived price outside the range must abort rather than clamp.

properties.name: pair_immutability
properties.statement: The (Meme, Quote) pair used to derive these values is fixed at launch and identical at migration. No route, retry, or recovery path may change it.

properties.name: display_price_is_not_terminating
properties.statement: The exact display price the three nine-decimal-meme cases share is a non-terminating rational: 66666666666666667 has prime factors other than 2 and 5. Any decimal rendering is therefore a rounded presentation value, never the exact quantity. The exact rational is authoritative; the decimal rounded to 34 places is provided for human comparison only and must not be used as a test oracle.
